name: cacheGet
description: Gets an object that is stored in the cache.

params.name: id
params.description: name of the element to return

params.name: throwWhenNotExist
params.description:
define if the functions throws an exception when the element does not exist.

Default is false.

params.name: cacheName
params.description: definition of the cache used by name, when not set the "default Object Cache" defined in Lucee Administrator is used instead.
